page_title: MAL 2-1 VLL | Mallorca v Valladolid 10/05/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Juan Pulido is looking at his watch and immediately ends this match.
90+5' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) is caught offside after the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Juan Pulido blows his whistle and it's Marcos Andre (Valladolid) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
90+3' Adam Aznou (Valladolid) is first to the rebound but his shot is blocked. Wow, what an escape there for the opposition.
90+2' Toni Lato (Mallorca) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Juan Pulido had an easy-decision to make.
90' The fourth official shows 6 min. of added time.
89' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Valladolid.
86' Cenk Ozkacar (Valladolid) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
85' Sergi Darder goes off the pitch and Toni Lato (Mallorca) comes on.
83' A corner kick by Valladolid is thwarted by the well prepared Dominik Greif (Mallorca).
82' The game has come to an end for Eray Comert. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Marcos Andre (Valladolid).
82' The current number of shots on goal is 4:6.
80' Valladolid failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
79' The attendance for today's match is 16018.
76' Substitution. Daniel Rodriguez leaves the pitch and is replaced by Mateu Morey Bauza (Mallorca).
74' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Selim Amallah leaves the pitch and Darwin Machis (Valladolid) comes on.
74' Here is a change. Raul Moro is going off and Alvaro Rubio gives the last tactical orders to Anuar (Valladolid).
73' The corner is swung in but Mallorca can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.
71' Antonio Sanchez (Mallorca) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post.
66' The referee allows time for a substitution. Takuma Asano will be replaced by Cyle Larin (Mallorca).
66' Substitution. Cyle Larin receives a signal from the referee and is now allowed to enter the pitch as Takuma Asano (Mallorca) walks off.
64' Vedat Muriqi (Mallorca) takes a sweet touch after collecting a precise cross. He produces a nice effort that whistles just past the left post.
58' Alvaro Rubio has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Florian Grillitsch (Valladolid) replacing Antonio Candela.
58' Substitution. Ivan Sanchez (Valladolid) replaces Chuki.
55' The goal by Valladolid is DISALLOWED on the advice of the video assistant referee due to an offside.
54' Cenk Ozkacar (Valladolid) heads the ball into the top left corner after a splendid cross. This timely header produces a wonderful moment.
54' Now Valladolid have a corner.
52' Valladolid have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
49' 2 - 1 Sergi Darder (Mallorca) collects a pass and without hesitation fires an unstoppable shot inside the right post.
48' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Mallorca comes to nothing.
46' The second half gets underway.
45+3' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Takuma Asano (Mallorca) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.
45' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) connects with the corner kick around the penalty spot, but steers his header inches over the bar.
44' Mallorca will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
44' Superb goalkeeping! Martin Valjent (Mallorca) is given too much space inside the goalmouth and heads the ball towards the right post, but the keeper shows his fast reflexes to keep the ball out.
43' Mallorca have a corner.
41' Valladolid can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
41' A snap shot by Luis Perez (Valladolid) from the edge of the area flies towards the bottom right corner, but Dominik Greif produces a good save to thwart him.
37' The current number of shots on goal is 2:4.
37' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Juan Pulido has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
34' Antonio Raillo (Mallorca) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card without any hesitation from the referee.

33' Juanmi Latasa (Valladolid) gets into a good shooting position. He wins some space for himself and drills a long-range daisy-cutter towards the middle of the goal. His good effort is, however, superbly saved by Dominik Greif!
31' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Mallorca.
28' 1 - 1 What a brilliant finish! Omar Mascarell (Mallorca) latches on to an inch-perfect cross into the box and fires the ball past the helpless goalkeeper.

25' Andre Ferreira makes a sensational save to thwart a great chance. A rebound falls to Takuma Asano (Mallorca) inside the box and he strikes goalwards, but the ball ends up in the keeper's gloves instead of the bottom left corner.
25' Sergi Darder (Mallorca) fires a powerful shot which is blocked.
21' Valladolid take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.
19' Chuki (Valladolid) has a good chance to get on the scoresheet and fires the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it goes narrowly over the crossbar.

19' Chuki (Valladolid) must feel embarrassed now. He received a killer pass, but his shot from the six-yard box was a disaster. He miskicked and made it very easy for Dominik Greif to get hold of the ball.

17' Johan Mojica (Mallorca) commits a foul on his opponent and it looks like it should be the other way around at first glance, but the referee makes the right decision in awarding a free kick to the other team.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Cenk Ozkacar (Valladolid) was quite harsh and Juan Pulido didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
11' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Raul Moro finds Chuki (Valladolid) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball inside the right post. 0:1.
9' None of the Valladolid players could reach the corner kick as the ball was overhit and goes out of play.
9' Valladolid quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
8' The resulting set piece from Valladolid is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
8' Eray Comert (Valladolid) makes a good run inside the box to meet a precise cross. He latches on to it and shoots, but the goalkeeper pulls off an excellent save.
6' Luis Perez (Valladolid) whips the ball in, but it fails to reach any of his teammates as the opposition's defence averts the threat. Valladolid force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) manages to dispossess his opponent of the ball, but he commits a foul in the process and the referee blows his whistle. Mallorca win a free kick.
1' It looks like Tamas Nikitscher (Valladolid) saw red with that tackle. Juan Pulido won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
1' The first half has started.
Valladolid will kick-off.
Juan Pulido got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
